Recommended position: One local service on a development laptop; tablet is an optional LAN client.
Reason: Core review must cold-start without Earth. The laptop represents an onboard node, not flight-qualified hardware.
Alternative or change trigger: Standalone disconnected tablet would require a separate native/local data architecture and recovery study.

Recommended position: Nuxt 4, Vue 3 and TypeScript; client-only static build.
Reason: Routing and layouts support a multi-view review workflow. Serve built assets locally; no runtime CDN or web-font dependency.
Alternative or change trigger: Vite plus Vue is the leaner alternative if Nuxt conventions add work. React is reasonable if the actual team is more proficient.

Recommended position: FastAPI with Pydantic validation; Python owns domain computations.
Reason: A Python boundary fits source parsers and analytical processing while exposing an explicit API.
Alternative or change trigger: Use Fastify if a TypeScript-only team can demonstrate the same parsing, validation and numerical behavior with less delivery risk.

Recommended position: OpenAPI-generated TypeScript types and openapi-fetch; validate at runtime on the server.
Reason: Avoid two manually maintained API schemas. Types alone do not validate received JSON.
Alternative or change trigger: Add client runtime decoding for untrusted persisted responses or protocol boundaries if necessary.

Recommended position: SQLite, owned by one backend service, for the first local prototype.
Reason: Transactions, revisions and the outbox matter more than the size of the research archive. Readers never open the live DB through Drive.
Alternative or change trigger: Move to local PostgreSQL when measured write contention, independent writers or database-level row policy justify the extra service. Offline operation does not require SQLite.

Recommended position: SQLAlchemy 2.x and Alembic; named constraints and reviewed migrations.
Reason: The backend owns transactions and schema changes. ORM portability does not prove identical semantics on another database.
Alternative or change trigger: Keep persistence interfaces small. Re-test migrations, types, constraints and transactions before any PostgreSQL migration.

Recommended position: Use a maintained SQLite build with the WAL-reset fix; verify linked engine version.
Reason: The current WAL documentation records a concurrency bug fixed in 3.51.3 and selected backports. Python package version alone does not identify the linked engine.
Alternative or change trigger: Qualify journal mode and synchronous policy on the actual filesystem; retain a tested rollback-journal option if needed.

Recommended position: Keep original EDF/images/source files as immutable objects. Use Parquet and DuckDB for selected derived analytical data.
Reason: A scalar clinical record, a waveform and a research file have different access patterns and meanings.
Alternative or change trigger: Parquet is optional in the first narrow episode. Add it when actual sample volume and query measurements justify it.

Recommended position: Durable database jobs, short transactions, a bounded worker and a transactional outbox.
Reason: A process restart must not erase accepted work or duplicate a released packet.
Alternative or change trigger: Consider a separate queue/workflow service only after durable single-service execution is insufficient.

Recommended position: Start with approved evidence sections, structured IDs and SQLite FTS5 lexical retrieval.
Reason: Applicability, source revision and exact citations come before embedding similarity.
Alternative or change trigger: Add embeddings or a vector index only when a held-out retrieval set shows important misses that the addition fixes.

Recommended position: First candidate: local llama.cpp server behind the backend; unavailable-model fallback always works.
Reason: Portable CPU/GPU support and structured-output options fit a small local experiment.
Alternative or change trigger: Ollama is a convenience alternative. MLX LM is an Apple-silicon alternative. Larger serving stacks require a measured need and supported hardware.

Recommended position: Evaluate Qwen3.5-4B for bounded explanation and handoff drafting; compare against a non-model template.
Reason: The publisher provides an Apache-2.0 model. General benchmarks do not establish correctness for this task.
Alternative or change trigger: MedGemma 1.5 4B is a research comparator subject to HAI-DEF terms and its clinical-use limitations. Exact revision, quantization and runtime compatibility remain open.

Recommended position: Defer fine-tuning. First test templates, retrieval and an unmodified candidate model.
Reason: No permitted, representative, task-labeled training/evaluation corpus has yet been established.
Alternative or change trigger: Adopt fine-tuning only for a documented failure mode with permitted labels and held-out improvement; preserve participant/study split integrity.

Recommended position: Stable task views: attention, evidence, next step, follow-up and handoff. AI supplies validated content inside fixed controls.
Reason: NASA automation guidance supports visible mode, authority, limitations and takeover. A generated explanation cannot change action authority.
Alternative or change trigger: A2UI is optional when multiple renderers or a larger catalog justify the protocol. Its catalog is not an authorization mechanism.

Recommended position: Begin with versioned file/replay adapters; qualify one optional real device separately.
Reason: Public vendor SDK documentation is not proof of a flight-system API or of access from the selected browser.
Alternative or change trigger: Use a native iOS/Android gateway for a documented SDK if a real sensor is selected. Capture the exact firmware payload before promising live integration.

Recommended position: Backend authorizes by identity, care relationship, purpose and current policy. Public demo uses synthetic records.
Reason: Role labels alone do not protect medical details. Command and technical support receive restricted projections.
Alternative or change trigger: Real-data evaluation requires authentication, key recovery, encryption, backup and privacy testing. SQLCipher is a candidate, not an implemented safeguard.
Requirements: RQ53; RQ54; RQ55; RQ56; RQ59; RQ60

Recommended position: One repository with a web app, a modular API, generated contracts and separately managed evidence manifests.
Reason: Each mutation has one owner. Keep records, model weights, large source files and keys outside Git.
Alternative or change trigger: Split services only at a measured operational or security boundary; the model process is already isolated.

Recommended position: Maintain separate local demo and public synthetic demo releases with the same contract version.
Reason: Judges need a public link; the local demo must also prove Earth-independent behavior.
Alternative or change trigger: A hosted stateful API needs durable storage. A serverless ephemeral filesystem is not a substitute for the local record.
